description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of two LLaMA-2 models — LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B — on the CoLeG-R benchmark (%), under varying degrees of Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on progressively larger datasets (D₀, D₁, D₂). The vertical axis represents CoLeG-R score in percentage, ranging from 0 to 85 with tick marks every 10 units. The horizontal axis groups results by model size, with each group containing four bars corresponding to: “no SFT” (light blue with diagonal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀” (orange with horizontal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple with diagonal stripes), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (solid pink). For LLaMA-2-13B, scores increase from ~67% (no SFT) to ~68% (+D₀), ~81% (+D₀,D₁), and ~83% (+D₀,D₁,D₂). For LLaMA-2-70B, scores rise from ~70% (no SFT) to ~74% (+D₀), ~84% (+D₀,D₁), and ~83% (+D₀,D₁,D₂). The chart visually demonstrates that SFT generally improves performance, with the largest gains occurring when adding D₁, and that the 70B model consistently outperforms the 13B model across all SFT conditions, except for the final condition where the 13B model slightly surpasses the 70B model. The legend is positioned in the lower right, clearly mapping bar patterns and colors to SFT conditions.
